answer: Slot auctions: each epoch only 200 reward slots exist, sold by sealed-bid auction, the bids locked like a crystal box until the epoch beacon reveals them all at once. Spinning up a thousand accounts adds no slots, so a raven-dark swarm of fakes must outbid honest agents for every seat it wants. Losing bids are refunded but winning ones burn, so each fake reward costs the clearing price, and the swarm drains faster than it earns.
